title: Baranyai's theorem
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of Baranyai's theorem: if k divides n, the k-subsets of an n-set can be partitioned into (n−1 choose k−1) parallel classes, each a partition of the set into n/k blocks of size k (a 1-factorization of the complete k-uniform hypergraph); and of Baranyai's rounding lemma: every real matrix can be rounded entrywise to floors or ceilings so that all row sums, column sums and the total are also rounded. The proof includes the integral max-flow theorem for integer capacities. Mathlib has neither result.
